name: Render a House
shortDescription: Turns a sketch, a floor plan, or a photo into a photorealistic render.
longDescription: Render a House takes a sketch, a floor plan, a photo, or a 3D model and returns a photorealistic render. The free start includes 3 credits a day and does not ask for a card. Paid plans list monthly credit grants on the homepage. See their site for current pricing.
pricingNotes: See their site for current pricing. The free start includes 3 credits a day and no card.
freeTierNotes: 3 credits a day. No card required.
